pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Types of Divorce? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Types of Divorce with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of Divorce.
   C. Use Types of Divorce to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Types of Divorce has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Asbabu al- nuzuul? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Asbabu al- nuzuul.
   B. Apply the teaching of Asbabu al- nuzuul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Asbabu al- nuzuul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Asbabu al- nuzuul has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected verses Surah al- Furqan has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected verses Surah al- Furqan.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Selected verses Surah al- Furqan to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

5. Which response best shows understanding of Prayers on special occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prayers on special occasions.
   B. Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Prayers on special occasions to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Prayers on special occasions has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Care for widows? (1 mark)
   A. Say Care for widows has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Care for widows.
   C. Apply the teaching of Care for widows with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Care for widows to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

8. Which response best shows understanding of Administration of Zakat? (1 mark)
   A. Say Administration of Zakat has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Administration of Zakat.
   C. Use Administration of Zakat to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Administration of Zakat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Funeral Rites? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Funeral Rites with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Funeral Rites to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Funeral Rites has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Funeral Rites.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Say Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

12. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.
   C. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues: honesty and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Muslim Dynasties: Rise of the Umayyad Dynasty Selected Umayyad Caliphs: Muawiya  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Muslim Dynasties and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Apply the teaching of Types of Divorce with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. B — Apply the teaching of Asbabu al- nuzuul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. C — Apply the teaching of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

5. B — Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Apply the teaching of Care for widows with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

8. D — Apply the teaching of Administration of Zakat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A — Apply the teaching of Funeral Rites with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. B — Apply the teaching of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

12. D — Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Virtues: honesty; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Prohibitions in Islam; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Muslim Dynasties: Rise of the Umayyad Dynasty Selected Umayyad Caliphs: Muawiya ; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Muslim Dynasties; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
